title: Exact paragraph reading: corrected image records
instructions: The three model replies remain unchanged. All six saved image-only records now separate original source context from the actual supplied image. Inputs, expected output, actual output and differences are shown in order. This is a bookkeeping correction with no new model call, not a new accuracy judgment. Comments are optional.

questions.prompt: Optional comments to steer later work

evidence.label: 1 · Inputs: image and selected paragraph only
evidence.text:
The actual request supplies only the registered paragraph area from the saved appendix image. The 502 × 127 image copies exactly the original pixels from (20, 457) to (522, 584), with no resizing or retouching. All 63,754 pixels were checked against their original coordinates. The full original image is unchanged. The model sees a rectangle covering the entire smaller image; adjacent paragraphs are absent. The model receives no OCR text, older proposal or expected reading. Model and generation settings match the earlier appendix audits. Those full nine-target audit outcomes remain separate and unchanged.

Actual instruction:
Transcribe only the indented quoted statute paragraph in the left column, inside the supplied target rectangle of image I1. No OCR or older transcription is supplied. Inspect every word, name, number, repetition and punctuation mark. Return the complete paragraph, including its quotation marks, in reading. Join only clear word wraps at printed line ends; preserve genuine hyphens. Do not add text from neighboring paragraphs or columns. Do not silently repair unusual printed words or repetitions for fluency. Use the declared JSON. For complete coverage, reading contains the full paragraph and reason is null. For partial coverage, reading may contain visible text or null, and reason explains the limitation. For unreadable coverage, reading is null and reason explains why. Never claim complete coverage when part of the paragraph is unreadable. This is unreviewed image-only evidence, not accepted historical text.

evidence.label: 2 · Expected output: source-inspected paragraph
evidence.text:
A satisfactory reply transcribes the whole selected quotation, preserves its words, section number and punctuation, and joins clear printed word wraps. If it cannot read part, it must say partial or unreadable and explain why. The following full reading is an agent illustration inspected against the saved scan before the calls; it is not an independent human reference or a byte-exact typography standard. The illustration does not settle how to represent the small capital letters used for the section label.

"Sec. 13. And be it further enacted, That the President is hereby authorized, at any time hereafter, by proclamation, to extend to persons who may have participated in the existing rebellion in any State or part thereof, pardon and amnesty, with such exceptions and at such time and on such conditions as he may deem expedient for the public welfare."

Checks: printed be rather than the raw OCR he, section 13, comma after enacted, complete quotation and no neighboring text. These expected words were not included in the model request.

evidence.label: 4 · Differences: agent comparison with the scan
evidence.text:
Run 1 — The first crop-only reply returns the full intended quotation, correctly reading be and section 13. Its words and internal punctuation match the source-inspected illustration; only the outer quotation marks differ. No neighboring text is included. The actual sent PNG is verified against the parent pixels. A separate metadata issue remains: the copied generic projection retains original full-image descriptors, while the actual request and export correctly identify the crop. Those inherited fields cannot certify actual-image geometry or native fit.

Run 2 — The second crop-only reply again returns the full intended quotation with correct be, section 13, words and internal punctuation. It uses capitalized SEC and curved outer quotes; those typography variants are recorded separately. No neighboring text appears. Both completed crop observations agree on the source word sequence, but the third identical observation is still required. Actual image/body hashes remain verified; inherited original-context projection descriptors stay disclosed and unchanged during this group.

Run 3 — The third crop-only reply again returns the intended full quotation, with correct be, section 13, all words and internal punctuation. It matches run 2 in reading and differs from run 1 only in section-label capitalization. Curved outer quote style is retained. No neighboring text appears. All three fixed crop requests therefore agree on the source word sequence for this exposed paragraph, unlike the full-image selection failure. This is selected AI source assessment, not general accuracy or proof of the backend mechanism; the inherited projection metadata limitation remains explicitly disclosed.

All three planned observations are saved; failures and disagreements are retained.

This experiment preserves the selected paragraph, instruction, reply format, model and settings from the full-image reading. It changes the supplied image and coordinate metadata. Context and backend image resizing may both differ, so agreement or improvement does not isolate the internal mechanism. The model also brings learned language expectations. Source inspection here is AI assessment, not human acceptance or a population accuracy rate.

evidence.label: 5 · Costs and limits
evidence.text: Actual request cycles total 61.50 seconds, known usage 1,002 input / 411 output tokens, 0 unknown-usage calls. Exact scope is one original paragraph in the unchanged full image. Three calls are planned, each limited to 300 seconds and 1,500 output tokens, with 600 seconds including preparation and reporting, and 1,800 seconds for the group. No retries, image fetches, model downloads or original-text edits. Earlier work includes 19 attempts taking 1,902.59 seconds, with 108,118 reported input tokens and 7,346 output tokens, plus three attempts whose token usage is unknown. Those costs remain in the record. Native internal image/input fit remains unknown. Inherited generic projection image hashes and regions still describe the original source context, while the actual request/export/crop proof identifies the supplied PNG. Those inherited fields must not be used as actual crop geometry or fit evidence; a separately labelled record is required after this frozen group. This is not a forecast of successful corpus cleanup or approval of a clean layer.

evidence.label: 7 · Image record correction: all six saved records
evidence.text:
Actual output — all six additive corrected records now distinguish the original source context from the actual model input.

For the three crop requests: the original source is the 1,600 × 876 image with nine original paragraph areas. The actual input is PNG, 502 × 127 pixels, paragraph P8, rectangle (0, 0) to (502, 127).

For the three full-image requests: the actual image is 1,600 × 876 pixels, with the requested P8 area from (20, 457) to (522, 584). This describes the requested selection; the wrong-neighbor model reply remains a failure.

Differences — the labels and structure are corrected. Every historical request, result, word and cost is unchanged, and every old record remains preserved. The older full-image media description was reconstructed from its frozen request; those original runs did not record a separate actual-image hash.

All 1,338 software checks pass, including mismatched image, dimensions, region, context and request refusals. Trust requires independently pinned source context and request bytes; a self-consistent record alone does not supply that authority. No model was called or rerun, and internal image fit remains unknown.
